channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Neil deGrasse Tyson — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-07
item.description: “The good thing about science is that it's true whether or not you believe in it.” — Neil deGrasse Tyson

item.title: Johannes Gaertner — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-06
item.description: “To speak gratitude is courteous and pleasant, to enact gratitude is generous and noble, but to live gratitude is to touch Heaven.” — Johannes Gaertner

item.title: Ernest Hemingway — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-05
item.description: “The best way to find out if you can trust somebody is to trust them.” — Ernest Hemingway

item.title: Carl Jung — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-04
item.description: “The creation of something new is not accomplished by the intellect but by the play instinct.” — Carl Jung

item.title: Mother Teresa — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-03
item.description: “Spread love everywhere you go. Let no one ever come to you without leaving happier.” — Mother Teresa

item.title: Holmes — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-02
item.description: “Fame usually comes to those who are thinking about something else.” — Holmes

item.title: Paulo Coelho — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-01
item.description: “Write your plans in pencil and give God the eraser.” — Paulo Coelho

item.title: Rabindranath Tagore — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-31
item.description: “Don't limit a child to your own learning, for he was born in another time.” — Rabindranath Tagore
